rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; two points, both outside the slice. (1) i1040s8812 p. 7, Earned Income Chart, first row: "have net earnings from self-employment" "use either optional method to figure those net earnings," "the amount figured using the Earned Income Worksheet next (even if you are also taking the EIC)." The optional methods are refused upstream through person.se_screen, whose question includes "electing an optional method (Schedule SE Part II)", raised by person.se_screened on Schedule SE (person.se_line2, "optional methods", i1040sse pp. 1-5), which every self-employment path into line 18a reads (Schedule 1 line 15 on the Earned Income Worksheet path, EIC Worksheet B line 4b on the EIC path); so the chart's first row never applies to a return the tool completes. The rendered English, which shows only line 18a's own operands, cannot show that refusal. (2) Combat pay: i1040s8812 p. 7, Earned Income Chart, taking the EIC: "plus all of your nontaxable combat pay if you did not elect to include it in earned income for the EIC". Nontaxable combat pay is refused: s8812.eiw_1b, which line 18b copies, refuses when s8812.combat_pay ("Did you receive any nontaxable combat pay in 2025 ...?"), and line 18b is evaluated on every return (shown_when only hides it), so a return with combat pay refuses and the added amount is zero on every return the tool completes. The rendered 18a line shows only its own operands. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; two points, both refused upstream (S4). (1) i1040s8812 p. 7, Earned Income Chart, first row: a filer who has "net earnings from self-employment" and will "use either optional method to figure those net earnings" uses "the amount figured using the Earned Income Worksheet next (even if you are also taking the EIC)". The optional methods are refused through person.se_screened (person.se_screen asks about, among others, the Schedule SE optional methods; refusal form "Schedule SE items outside this tool (... optional methods ...)", forms/2025/person.yaml), which every self-employment path into line 18a reads, so that row never applies to a return the tool completes. (2) Combat pay: the same chart, taking the EIC, adds "all of your nontaxable combat pay if you did not elect to include it in earned income for the EIC". Nontaxable combat pay is refused: s8812.eiw_1b refuses on s8812.combat_pay ("Any nontaxable combat pay (Form W-2, box 12, code Q)?", remedy "Nontaxable combat pay is outside this tool."), and line 18b, shown under the same s8812.show_iia as line 18a, copies s8812.eiw_1b, so every return that reaches line 18a with combat pay is refused. The rendered English (rendered/2025/s8812.md, line 18a) shows only the line's own operands and cannot show refusals on other lines; the model read the page correctly. Same ruling as round 2 and the Stage 19 Claude log (render.s8812.json); Stage 19 did not change this line. Project stands.
